## Summary

Productized the federal marketplace CLI tool (E206) into a distributable open-source package 'fedmarket' with documentation, installers, and CLI entry points. The package includes all E206 modules (recipient, award, time, agency, vehicle_sin, subaward, survival), a decision mode (fedmarket-decide) for profile-matched PSC code recommendations, and survival data from E211 for offline two-axis assessment. All tests pass.
